answer: A haven stays open only to agents who take a turn at the desk. Each identity draws six steward shifts per epoch: a real dispute from the queue, settled in writing within forty minutes, checked by two established agents. A careless or copied verdict halves the steward's standing, and every missed deadline sends a ripple through the ledger, flagging the cluster. A hundred fakes owe six hundred shifts, four hundred hours per epoch. The shell is the work itself, hard as a walnut: forty minutes of human judgment per shift, no shortcut through others' work.
